source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, cash income taxes paid
source.quote: During the fiscal years ended June 30, 2025, 2024 and 2023, the Company paid gross income taxes of $ 208 million, $ 156 million and $ 149 million, respectively, and received income tax refunds of $ 4 million, $ 17 million and $ 13 million, respectively.

notes: Taxes: us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaid, gross, before refunds. R&D not reported as a separate line in the FY2025 10-K. Taxes: the 10-K states gross income taxes paid of $208 million (us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaid) and, separately, income tax refunds received of $4 million; the gross figure is recorded and no net figure is computed.
